Class Matrix<T extends RingElement<T>>

java.lang.Object
AbstractMath.Rings.Structures.Matrix.Matrix<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the entry type, which supplies its own ring operations
All Implemented Interfaces:
RingElement<Matrix<T>>
public final class Matrix<T extends RingElement<T>> extends Object implements RingElement<Matrix<T>>
An immutable square matrix over one ring. Input lists are copied and entries must themselves be immutable ring elements. Use a Builder to assign entries individually before creating a complete matrix. The constructor validates shape and requires every entry to have the same nested type.

  • Constructor Details

    • Matrix

      public Matrix(int rows, int columns, List<List<T>> defaultValues)
      Copies complete initial rows into a fixed square matrix.
      Parameters:
      rows - the positive row count
      columns - the positive column count, which must equal rows
      defaultValues - exactly the requested rows and columns of nonnull entries
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if dimensions or list sizes do not match, or entries have different nested types
      NullPointerException - if any list, row, or entry is null
